title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in Modern DWV Systems
description: Choosing the right material for drain-waste-vent (DWV) systems depends on acoustic requirements, cost, and installation environment. Schedule 40 PVC is lightweight, cost-effective, and highly resistant to chemical corrosion, making it the industry standard for single-family residential drainage. However, PVC transmits water flow noise easily through walls. Cast iron pipe, connected with no-hub couplings, offers superior sound damping due to its high density, making it ideal for multi-story residential buildings, commercial spaces, and main vertical stacks where acoustic comfort is critical. Understanding material properties helps plumbers select the correct piping based on building design specifications and client expectations.
